reviews.text: Even when conditions are perfect this place is still a hassle
The service was excellent.

I had a very disappointing experience during my visit around 9:00 a.m. I came in because I wanted my cat's ear checked for possible ear mites or an infection. The receptionist, who I was told was named “Melly”, she had ginger hair, was rude and dismissive from the moment I walked in. She appeared annoyed before I had even explained why I was there.

She asked if I had filled out the large form, and I told her I had only completed the small one because that's what I've always been asked to fill out during previous visits. No one directed me to complete the larger form when I arrived. Instead of politely explaining the process, she spoke to me in a disrespectful manner.

She then told me they couldn't check my cat because they were full. There were only about four people in the waiting room, so I was confused. I simply said that I just wanted someone to quickly look at his ear—I wasn't asking for a full exam. Another employee overheard the conversation and was trying to help by seeing if a veterinarian or doctor could quickly take a look at my cat's ear. While she was trying to help me, Melly repeatedly told her, "You can't do that," in front of me, without explaining why. It felt like she was more focused on shutting down the conversation than trying to help.

I understand clinics get busy and have policies, but there's no excuse for treating customers this way. Her attitude made an already stressful visit much worse. Every other staff member I encountered was kind, respectful, and genuinely helpful, which made her behavior stand out even more.

I hope management reviews this interaction. Front desk staff are the first people customers interact with, and they should treat people with professionalism, kindness, and respect, especially when they're worried about their pet's health.

Worst experience I’ve ever had with a business. Firstly, they misdiagnosed my French bulldog who sadly passed due to their negligent/careless action(obviously as a grieving pet owner I had a less than favorable reaction and threatened suit, it’s the lawyer in me, however I backed off and grieved). After a year and a half I tried to give them another shot and they book me an appointment for my cat and week and a half out, I come in and they inform me they can see me because of my “previous interaction” with them, causing me to lose my entire morning due again to their carelessness and failure to appropriately calendar and file away “displeased clients”. So I’ll simply say I do not recommend this place at all, and customer service was lacking in each and every sense.

I took my Dog Otis here for a checkup for the first time today he got all hyper with other dogs and they keep me in the back his  is all good and there prices are  not that Bad i will bring him there when i can I love the stuff they are nice and understanding  i give them 5stars I will recommend to families and friends

I’ve been coming to this clinic for years for two generations worth of cats now. I used to take my senior kitties here before they passed away and they were treated with the upmost respect. I’m really grateful for this team because they saw me through the passing of both of those senior kitties and we’re extremely empathetic anytime I needed to bring them in for an emergency service.

I now have three new kitties who are young and I only trust this place to care for them. The prices are great and they always make a point to fit you in wherever they can. I seriously can’t recommend this place enough and wish most animal hospitals were like this place!

The workers here are very nice and got me and my dog in and out in a reasonable time! It was our first visit as a new puppy and they got all our information and we got to see the vet pretty quickly! Definitely will be back!
Always a good experience
Love the team here, and Dr. Heidi is awesome! 🤩

I had been taking my dog Charlie there for years until she moved to San Diego and no longer used their services. When my GF adopted a new puppy, Lucy I was really excited to go back to HP. They are so amazing in every way and so appreciate the way the whole team works together. The wait is not long at all even as a walk in and they are so sweet to all the animals that come in to be seen. A very calm and relaxing time every time I go in and the rates are unbeatable. Truly a blessing to have found this place full of wonderful people that actually care about animals. They never give off a “I just work here” vibe and they get things done quickly and efficiently. Thank you guys for all the love.
Great service. Clean office. Fast and efficient.

the way they charge is a rip-off , exaggerated prices, a real rip-off
stay away from that veterinary clinic
They've always been good at what they do. Very kind and considerate to you and your little ones.

This is a wonderful animal hospital with terrific doctors and the staff are absolutely the BEST.  Nothing is too much to ask.  They are all kind, compassionate, efficient and patient. I highly recommend the Highland Park Animal Hospital.  They even have times you can walk-in and if they are not too busy will see your pet. In my experience they have been able to see my dogs 95 percent of the time through the walk in process.    They also have discounts on vaccinations Tuesdays and Thursdays. 5 Stars all around.

I am 100% recommend this hospital reasonable prices super friendly, especially the girl in the front desk on the right super knowledgeable as well my dog got attacked by a pitbull. I have a Frenchie my dog needed surgery My dog was sent home with drainage tubes hospital was checking up on her calling to see if she was OK they are very attentive the doctors are amazing here

Took my dog here several times. Doctor here kept suggesting we give our dog Gatorade because she was dehydrated. That was the medical advice. Spent a few hundred for it, Had another doctor here who examined her and they found a tumor on her lymph node. Turns out she had cancer. Waited forever, too.

Only issue I have with this clinic is they are never open during their said operation times. Whenever we try coming in before their closing times we see they have locked up the gates. Don’t say you are  open before 1 pm but close your doors 30 minutes prior. If you guys close earlier on certain days, please consider fixing the hours online so we can plan accordingly. It’s unfair to my pet and our time.

Good services
Front end staff are awful
Thank you for your expertise and care of my feline companion Cornelius!
They are the nicest people ever. I  been there a couple of times.
My family has continually received the best care for our pets for over 35 years!
Oreo (my dog) 15yo received quality care. Doctors and staff are friendly and helpful. Walked in and was seen in a reasonable amount of time.
- 1 star because there's no back side sitting area for you and your pet.
It's alwsys the best lovi g care for our friend

I was given a spay neuter certificate by Los Angeles Animal Services and I selected Highland Park Animal Hospital from the pre-approved veterinary list which said they spayed rabbits. I went on the train with my rabbit at 4 a.m. and stood in line for three hours in the cold one to be rudely turned away by Tattoo from Fantasy Island saying they didn't service rabbits.
Bad enough we froze for three hours but this worker needs some people skills.

Been going there for 15 years, but they still want to leave you on hold for 25 minutes only to tell you that they cannot see you at all even though it’s urgent but not emergency.  What happened to all of the family vet businesses that cared about long standing patients and knew your name?
Great location with parking, but very hard to make an appointment. Must be on hold for many minutes. Once the appointment is made everyone is nice and helpful.
Somewhere between normal vet and clinic style. Appreciate in a time where vet care is becoming more and more inaccessible both cost and scheduling related.
Expect to be on hold for 10 minutes. You’ve got a better chance getting help calling a vet that’s a 10 min drive away.
Helpful great pupstomer service 🐕‍🦺 caring …

I want to thank all the staff. They are really polite and helpful.
I have been there four times and I am happy with the service provided

Great clinic, friendly staff, but a little disorganized.  A little frustrating after coming back to grab my pup after he was said to be ready and waited almost an hour just to pay and speak with the doctor for 30 seconds which was the same instructions that were handed to me and on the pill bottle.
We had to sadly put down my 15 yr old cat and they were so gentle and loving.
Love this veterinarian hosp. The staff is the best. They are kind and helpful. The vets are very professional and knowledgeable. Thank you so much for taking such good care of ZuZu and Kaboo.

DO NOT TAKE YOUR PET HERE - money hungry jerks that would rather charge you more money for unnecessary work, than care for your pet! They do not care about the wellbeing of your pet, it is only about how much money they can get from you!!!
